train_rq: train a residual quantizer with configurable sub-quantizers and beam size using FAISS
train_QINCo: train a QINCo model on training data with Adam optimizer and learning rate scheduling
train_QINCo_multi_gpu: train a QINCo model across multiple GPUs using DistributedDataParallel and NCCL backend
initialize_model: initialize a QINCo model by copying RQ centroids into codebook weights
compute_MSE: compute mean squared error on a validation set using the trained QINCo model
